q: The Jordan–Kinderlehrer–Otto theorem (1998) identifies the Fokker–Planck equation ∂_t ρ = ∇·(ρ∇V) + Δρ as:
opts: The gradient flow of the free energy ℱ(ρ)=∫Vρ dx + ∫ρ log ρ dx in Wasserstein space
exp: JKO: the Fokker–Planck equation is the gradient flow (steepest descent) of the free energy functional in the Wasserstein metric. The energy descent direction is the 'Wasserstein gradient' of ℱ. This connects PDEs, optimal transport, and thermodynamics.
